# Calculate wheel positions
# Body dimensions: 200x100x100
# Wheels: radius 25, thickness 10, half embedded (radius 12.5 embedded)

# Wheel centers should be at:
# - X: near corners, so at x=25 and x=175 (25 from each end)
# - Y: front wheels at y=25, rear wheels at y=75 (centered on the 100 width)
# - Z: at z=12.5 (half the radius, so wheels are half embedded)

# Front left wheel
fl_x, fl_y, fl_z = 25, 25, 12.5

# Front right wheel  
fr_x, fr_y, fr_z = 175, 25, 12.5

# Rear left wheel
rl_x, rl_y, rl_z = 25, 75, 12.5

# Rear right wheel
rr_x, rr_y, rr_z = 175, 75, 12.5

print(f"Front left wheel: ({fl_x}, {fl_y}, {fl_z})")
print(f"Front right wheel: ({fr_x}, {fr_y}, {fr_z})")
print(f"Rear left wheel: ({rl_x}, {rl_y}, {rl_z})")
print(f"Rear right wheel: ({rr_x}, {rr_y}, {rr_z})")

# All wheels point horizontally along Y-axis (thickness 10)
print("\nAll wheels have height vector: (0, 10, 0)")
print("All wheels have radius: 25")
